text:
Jordan (Sales): Hey team — Navis Health wants a 2-hour POC next Wed 09:00 PST. They want a hosted demo with cross-region capacity (US + EU), burst up to ~800 QPS total, model: open-llama-13B, avg seq ~200 tokens. Requirements: ephemeral/scoped keys, IP allowlist, EU data residency for EU traffic, and a fallback plan to Dedicated if hosted capacity is exceeded. Can we provision a temporary scoped key/window and a cost ballpark?
Alex (Eng-Infra): We can do scoped ephemeral keys + IP allowlist. Note hosted default QPS per account is ~100. Granting a temporary burst window to ~800 QPS is possible but needs capacity approval and a controlled ramp. Suggest 2 keys (us/eu) and a canary ramp: 150 -> 400 -> 800.
Marie (SRE): FYI autoscale + cold-starts matter. If we spin up more nodes in eu it can add a couple seconds. For an interactive demo, recommend pre-warming a small fleet and shorter max seq or caching. Also we can route EU traffic to eu-west pinned region to satisfy residency, but large capacity there may not be guaranteed.
Sam (Product): Confirm model size — open-llama-13B should be fine. If they ask for anything >13B we probably need Dedicated. Also call out streaming vs non-streaming; streaming increases connection count and affects concurrency.
Jordan (Sales): They confirmed open-llama-13B and non-streaming responses. They asked for an expiry on keys (3 days) and strict IP allowlist. Also asks for an estimate for token/capacity cost for the 2-hour window.
Alex (Eng-Infra): I can create 2 scoped keys: navis-poc-us and navis-poc-eu with expiry 72h and IP allowlist. Proposed steady QPS per region 400, burst up to 800 for 10m windows. Need ops approval for capacity and a billing owner to sign the temporary cost. Example CLI to create a scoped key:
```
# admin CLI (example)
redwood keys create --name navis-poc-us --scope hosted --qps 900 --burst-window 600 --expires 72h --ips 34.120.0.0/14
```
Marie (SRE): We'll add a fallback policy: if 95p latency > 3s for 2 consecutive mins or error rate > 1%, route EU traffic to Dedicated eu-pool (if provisioned) or degrade to a lower-throughput model. Also will monitor token burn and surface alerts to the thread.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Quick cost ballpark: assume 2 regions, sustained 400 QPS each, avg 50 tokens/request (we should encourage them to lower seq): 2 regions * 400 qps * 3600s * 2 hours * 50 tokens = (Calculate inline simplified) — better to show a simpler estimate in the ticket. I'll produce a tidy estimate and line items (API token spend + capacity surcharge + ephemeral support).
Legal-Eric: Need to confirm data handling/deletion policy for ephemeral keys. Please attach the PO and confirm logs retention window.
quota-bot: Quota request created: req-205112-77. Status: pending capacity approval.
Jordan (Sales): Thanks — Alex, can you create the scoped keys once capacity ok and post the cost estimate here? Marie, please add the fallback rule to the runbook. Legal-Eric, I'll DM the PO and deletion policy.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Yep — will wait for capacity greenlight, then create keys and post exact CLI + example curl usage.
Marie (SRE): I'll pre-warm 2 nodes in eu region 10m before demo start and add the runbook snippet.
Jordan (Sales): Great — marking this thread as the primary coordination channel for Navis POC. Will follow up with exact demo window and PO shortly. :thumbsup:
